concerns.text: T015a (Truncate to N=120) and T015b (Compute SD on N=120) precede the calculation of entropy on the *scrubbed* data. FR-010 and FR-012 require SD and entropy to be computed on the time points *remaining after motion scrubbing* (variable length), not on a pre-truncated fixed length. The current order (T014 -> T015a -> T015b) forces truncation before entropy calculation, violating the data-flow dependency required by the spec.

T015c (Impute zero-variance parcels with cohort median) depends on the existence of the *entire cohort's* entropy values. However, T015c is placed inside the subject-loop (implied by T018 orchestration) and depends only on T015b (per-subject calculation). There is no preceding task to aggregate all subject entropy values to compute the 'cohort median' before T015c runs. This creates a circular dependency or a missing producer artifact.

T023c (Feature Selection on PCA components) and T024b (Train on Reduced Features) introduce a 'Reduced' connectivity baseline. However, SC-001 and SC-002 explicitly define success based on the 'Connectivity-only' model using the '200 components' (T023a). The tasks do not clearly distinguish which artifact (T023a vs T023c) is the 'Single Source of Truth' for the primary baseline comparison, risking ambiguity in the consumer (T024a) which relies on T023a but T024b relies on T023c.

T035 (Calculate correlation between mean entropy and mean FD) depends on T013c (FD stats) and T015c (Entropy features). However, T015c (Imputation) is currently dependent on T015b (Per-subject entropy). If T015c requires the cohort median (as per FR-009), it cannot be completed before the full cohort is processed. T035 depends on the *final* imputed features, but the dependency chain for T015c is broken (missing 'Compute Cohort Median' task), making T035's input artifact potentially incomplete or logically impossible to generate in the current order.

T046 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but describes adding a unit test to verify the order of operations (SD on truncated vs pre-truncated). While the test itself is parallel, the task description implies a dependency on the logic of T015b. If T015b is fixed, T046 is valid. However, the task description conflates implementation (adding validation) with testing, which might be better split or clarified to ensure the 'producer' (T015b logic) is fully established before the 'consumer' (T046 test) runs.
